spans.s: (often used in the Ṛg-veda, and sometimes only to lay stress on a following word; therefore by native etymologists [Nir.] considered as a particle of affirmation.) इत्था is often connected with words expressing devotion to the gods &c. in the sense of thus, truly, really
accord. to some also ‘here, hither’, ‘there, thither’, = Prākṛt ettha.
especially with धी as an adjective. Hence इत्था-धी = such, i.e. true (सत्या) or real worship. Similarly, इत्था-धी॑ mfn. so devout, so pious i.e. very devout
performing such or true works [Sāy.], RV.; AV.; KaṭhUp.
, thus, in this manner, RV.; AV.; TS.; R.; Śak.; &c.;
इत्थं—विध (इत्थं˚), mfn. of such a kind, endowed with such qualities, Bhartṛ.
इत्थम्—कारम् ind. in this manner, Pāṇ. iii, 4, 27.
इत्थ॑म्—भाव m. the being thus endowed.
इत्थम्—भूत mfn. become thus, being thus or in such manner
, N. of the third Yoga in astronomy.
(= इत्थम्), Ved. thus, in this way.
